Explore the shared platform +

The following platform features are available across all plans, subject to account availability, configuration and any external usage fees.

  • Booking confirmations and reminders
  • Rescheduling and cancellation links
  • No-show follow-up and booking payments
  • Conditional workflows and webhooks
  • Forms and lead capture
  • Landing pages, funnels and websites
  • Email campaigns
  • Social scheduling
  • A/B testing, blogs and publishing
  • Quotes, estimates and proposals
  • E-signatures
  • Invoices and payment links
  • Subscriptions and recurring invoices
  • Discounts and post-purchase offers
  • Review requests and monitoring
  • Dashboards and campaign reporting
  • Appointment, pipeline and revenue reporting
  • Courses, communities and client portal
  • API, integrations and shared resources

Feature availability does not include unlimited implementation. Start with your agreed setup hours, configure additional tools yourself or ask for a separately scoped service.

WhatsApp Business

Connection included.
Billable messages are pay-per-use.

Every plan includes the WhatsApp connection. It is not added again as a separate connection charge.

Marketing and utility messages are billed by actual usage. Rates, service-message treatment and any free allowances must be confirmed.

Additional setup & support

More help, when you need it.

US$250for a 5-hour support block

Use additional paid assistance for work beyond the initial setup and monthly support scope. Agree the work before it begins.

Paid-block renewal, expiry and rollover terms remain to be confirmed. Complex workflows, extra channels, integrations and data cleanup need an agreed scope.

What happens when an AI allowance runs out?+

For AI Growth, the intended choice is to stop the affected AI at the included allowance or enable paid overages with an agreed dollar-spend cap. Actual account behaviour must be checked before either is promised as an enforced cutoff.

Usage alerts and dollar-spend controls are separate from the included response and voice-minute counts. Agree notification settings, overage permissions and stop behavior with AyudaGrow. Reporting delays can affect control timing; a real-time hard cap is not yet verified.

What still needs confirmation before activation?+

AI Starter account eligibility; applicable Unlimited fair-use terms; unconfirmed tool allowances; actual messaging rates and service-message treatment; spend-control behaviour; and additional-support terms.

Voice AI and WhatsApp Calling require their own eligible setup. An AI plan does not automatically activate those channels. Business information, permissions and answers need the appropriate human review and approval.

Agree your plan's eligibility, usage allowances and applicable terms with AyudaGrow before activation.
